notice_period_confirmation.description:
I acknowledge that the notice period for this employee Employment Agreement Will be governed by the Singapore Employment Act, as specified below:

  1. One day’s notice if the person has been employed for less than 26 weeks;
  2. One week’s notice if the person has been employed for 26 weeks or more but less than 2 years;
  3. Two weeks’ notice if the person has been employed for 2 years or more but less than 5 years; and
  4. Four weeks’ notice if the person has been employed for 5 years or more.
